annexes.title: PSA Certificate of Death of Vicente Inocalla, Sr. (died 26 November 1984)
annexes.note: Referred to in paragraph 2 of the petition. Proves the death and the residence at death that fixes venue under Section 1, Rule 73.
annexes.missing: Not yet in hand. To be ordered from the Philippine Statistics Authority (README pathway, step 2) and inserted here before filing.

annexes.title: PSA Certificate of Death of Beatriz Villafria Inocalla (died 12 August 1985)
annexes.note: Referred to in paragraph 2 of the petition.
annexes.missing: Not yet in hand. To be ordered from the Philippine Statistics Authority (README pathway, step 2) and inserted here before filing.

annexes.title: Schedule of Heirs, Creditors and Other Interested Persons for Notice (Section 2, Rule 79)
annexes.note: Referred to in paragraphs 4 and 5 and prayer (b). One row per heir with name, age and residence, across the ten branches; the known creditors (Bureau of Internal Revenue; the local governments for real property tax); and the two persons named in paragraph 5.
annexes.missing: To be prepared by the petitioner with the family from the heir roster (README pathway, step 4) and inserted here before filing.

annexes.title: Certified true copy of TCT No. (44055) 002-2026001670, Registry of Deeds of Manila, restored to Beatriz V. Inocalla married to Vicente Inocalla on 16 April 2026; with the judgment, finality and execution records of Civil Case No. 13-131220, RTC Manila, Branch 15
annexes.note: Referred to in paragraphs 6(b), 7 and 11 and in the affidavit, paragraph 2.
files_desc: Attached: the Registry's electronic certified true copy, 5 pages, requested by Allan Inocalla on 5 August 2026 (OR No. 1040475498). Entry No. 2026004663 of 16 April 2026 on its memorandum of encumbrances recites the dispositive portion of the Decision of 15 February 2019 and the Certificate of Finality of 23 January 2020. The certified copies of the Decision, the Certificate of Finality and the alias writ of 9 March 2026 are in the petitioner's file and follow the title when the binder is assembled for filing.

annexes.title: Compromise Agreement of 24 January 1992 in Civil Case No. B-5625 (also cited as 5626), RTC Camarines Norte, Branch 41, Daet, for judicial partition; with the Order of 28 January 1992 approving it and the Certificate of Finality of 26 March 2014
annexes.note: Referred to in paragraphs 3 and 6 and in Annex G.
files_desc: Attached: the Compromise Agreement as filed, 6 pages, bearing the Branch 41 receiving stamp and the exhibit markings. The certified copies of the approving Order and of the Certificate of Finality are to be obtained from the Office of the Clerk of Court, RTC Branch 41, Daet (README pathway, step 5) and inserted after the agreement.

annexes.title: PSA Certificate of Live Birth of Allan V. Inocalla
annexes.note: Referred to in paragraph 11 and in the affidavit, paragraph 1. Proves filiation to the decedents and the petitioner's standing as next of kin under Section 6, Rule 78.
annexes.missing: Not yet in hand. To be ordered from the Philippine Statistics Authority (README pathway, step 3) and inserted here before filing.

annexes.title: Special powers of attorney in favor of the petitioner
annexes.note: Referred to in paragraph 11 and in the affidavit, paragraph 4.
files_desc: Attached: the heirs' special power of attorney acknowledged before the Philippine Embassy, Brasilia, on 10 July 2024, 4 pages, signed by Herbert, Jesus and Marilou Inocalla and Cipriana Inocalla Cambronero among others. The special power of attorney of Jesus V. Inocalla (Daet, August 2025, Doc. No. 518, Atty. Sherwin O. Mata) and of Marilou V. Inocalla (Paranaque City, 5 August 2025, Doc. No. 56, Page 24) are in the petitioner's file and follow this document when the binder is assembled for filing.

annexes.title: Schedule of Subject Properties (the schedule itself is bound with the petition at its page 12)
annexes.note: Referred to in paragraph 6 and prayer (a)(i).
annexes.missing: The schedule is printed as the last page of the petition. The tax declarations and assessed values of both properties, from the City of Manila and the Municipality of Paracale, are to be obtained (README pathway, step 5) and inserted here for the assessment of the docket fee.

annexes.title: Certified true copy of TCT No. T-2194, Registry of Deeds of Camarines Norte, in the name of Vicente Inocalla, married to Beatriz Villafria (Barrio Batobalani, Paracale, 13.3690 hectares)
annexes.note: Referred to in paragraphs 6(a) and 8, in the affidavit, paragraph 3, and in Annex G. Issued 11 July 2024 on the request of Allan Inocalla (Ref. No. 2024003960, OR No. 1031911034).
files_desc: Attached: pages 1 to 4 of the 5-page certified copy (the title page and the memorandum of encumbrances through the entry of 21 February 1994). Page 5 of 5, the additional sheet, is held by the petitioner on paper and is to be inserted after page 4.

annexes.title: Affidavit of Allan V. Inocalla in support of the petition (bound with the petition at its pages 9 to 11), with the records of Barangay 759, Zone 82, Santa Ana, City of Manila, in Barangay Case No. 001
annexes.note: Referred to in paragraphs 7, 8 and 9 and prayer (a)(iii).
files_desc: Attached: the Summons of the Office of the Lupong Tagapamayapa in Barangay Case No. 001 (for ejectment), Jesus V. Inocalla et al. v. Vicente de Leon Inocalla III and Elena de Leon Inocalla, setting the mediation for 23 January 2026, and the Certification to File Action, 2 pages. The blotter entry of 22 August 2025 and the complaint of 28 August 2025 are in the petitioner's file and follow these when the binder is assembled for filing.
